const state={module:0,chosen:{},checked:{},hints:{},attempts:{},firstTry:{},celebrated:{},revealed:{}};
const TOTAL=DATA.questions.length;
const CASE_COUNT=DATA.modules.length;
function escapeHTML(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
function vocab(s){let out=escapeHTML(s);Object.keys(DATA.vocab).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length).forEach(term=>{
 const safe=term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&');
 const p=new RegExp('\\b('+safe+')\\b','gi');
 out=out.replace(p,'<span class="tip" tabindex="0" role="note" aria-label="Vocabulary definition: '+escapeHTML(DATA.vocab[term])+'" data-tip="'+escapeHTML(DATA.vocab[term])+'">$1</span>');
});return out}
function totalSolved(){return Object.keys(state.checked).length}
function caseQuestions(m){return DATA.questions.map((q,i)=>({...q,i})).filter(q=>q.module===m.id)}
function caseSolved(m){return caseQuestions(m).filter(q=>state.checked[q.i]).length}
function completeCases(){return DATA.modules.filter(m=>caseSolved(m)===caseQuestions(m).length).length}
function detectiveRank(){let n=totalSolved();if(n===TOTAL)return 'Master Investigator';if(n>=15)return 'Lead Detective';if(n>=8)return 'Evidence Analyst';if(n>=3)return 'Rookie Investigator';return 'New Recruit'}
function render(){
 const m=DATA.modules[state.module],qs=caseQuestions(m),solved=totalSolved(),solvedHere=caseSolved(m),allCases=completeCases();
 document.getElementById('stats').textContent=solved+' / '+TOTAL+' clues resolved · '+allCases+' / '+CASE_COUNT+' cases closed';
 document.getElementById('bar').style.width=(100*solved/TOTAL)+'%';
 document.getElementById('rank').textContent=detectiveRank();
 document.getElementById('tabs').innerHTML=DATA.modules.map((x,i)=>{
   let c=caseSolved(x),t=caseQuestions(x).length,done=c===t;
   return '<button class="'+(i===state.module?'active ':'')+(done?'case-done':'')+'" onclick="chooseModule('+i+')" aria-current="'+(i===state.module?'page':'false')+'"><span>'+escapeHTML(x.tag)+(done?' ✓':'')+'</span><small>'+c+'/'+t+' clues</small></button>'
 }).join('');
 const caseClosed=solvedHere===qs.length;
 const missionHTML='<div class="mission-strip"><div><span class="micro">YOUR MISSION</span><p>Investigate the sources. Solve all '+qs.length+' clues to earn the <strong>'+escapeHTML(m.title)+' Case Badge</strong>.</p></div><div class="case-meter" aria-label="'+solvedHere+' of '+qs.length+' clues solved in this case"><strong>'+solvedHere+'/'+qs.length+'</strong><span>clues</span></div></div>';
 const figures=[{image:m.image,caption:m.caption},...m.extras].map(x=>'<figure class="figure"><img tabindex="0" onclick="enlargeImage(this)" onkeydown="enlargeKey(event,this)" src="'+x.image+'" alt="'+escapeHTML(x.caption)+'" loading="lazy"><figcaption>'+escapeHTML(x.caption)+' · Select image to enlarge</figcaption></figure>').join('');
 const reading=m.reading?'<div class="reading"><strong>'+escapeHTML(m.reading.label)+'</strong>'+m.reading.text.split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean).map(p=>'<p>'+vocab(p)+'</p>').join('')+'</div>':'';
 const qhtml=qs.map((q,k)=>{
   const selected=state.chosen[q.i],checked=state.checked[q.i],tried=(state.attempts[q.i]||0)>0,correct=selected===q.answer;
   const options=q.options.map((opt,i)=>'<button class="opt '+(selected===i?'selected ':'')+(checked&&i===q.answer?'correct':'')+'" '+(checked?'disabled':'')+' onclick="chooseAnswer('+q.i+','+i+')" aria-pressed="'+(selected===i?'true':'false')+'"><span class="letter">'+['A','B','C','D'][i]+'</span><span>'+vocab(opt)+'</span></button>').join('');
   const status=checked?'<span class="resolved-pill">✓ CLUE RESOLVED</span>':tried?'<span class="review-pill">↻ RECONSIDER</span>':'<span class="pending-pill">CLUE '+(k+1)+'</span>';
   let feedback='';
   if(checked){
      feedback='<div class="feedback good" role="status"><strong>'+(state.revealed[q.i]?'Evidence revealed — study the reasoning':state.firstTry[q.i]?'Excellent evidence work! +1 first-try star':'Case cracked!')+'</strong><div>'+vocab(q.explain)+'</div></div>';
   }else if(tried){
      feedback='<div class="feedback try" role="status"><strong>Not quite. Recheck the evidence.</strong><p>Think about which claim the source actually supports. You can revise your answer and try again. No penalty.</p><button class="secondary" onclick="revealAnswer('+q.i+')">Reveal answer and explanation</button></div>';
   }
   return '<article class="card"><div class="question-top"><div class="skill">'+escapeHTML(q.skill)+'</div>'+status+'</div><h3>'+vocab(q.prompt)+'</h3><div class="options">'+options+'</div><div class="actions"><button class="check" '+(selected===undefined||checked?'disabled':'')+' onclick="checkAnswer('+q.i+')">'+(tried?'Try this answer':'Check my thinking')+'</button><button class="secondary" onclick="toggleHint('+q.i+')">'+(state.hints[q.i]?'Hide clue':'🔎 Need a clue?')+'</button></div>'+(state.hints[q.i]?'<div class="hint">'+vocab(q.hint)+'</div>':'')+feedback+'</article>'
 }).join('');
 const badgesHTML=caseClosed?'<section class="badge-unlocked" aria-label="Case completed"><span class="badge-medal" aria-hidden="true">★</span><div><strong>CASE CLOSED · Badge unlocked!</strong><p>'+escapeHTML(m.title)+' — all evidence clues solved. '+(state.module===CASE_COUNT-1?'Check your final dossier below.':'Choose your next investigation above or below.')+'</p></div></section>':'';
 const end=solved===TOTAL?'<section class="end" role="status"><div class="final-stars">★ ★ ★ ★ ★</div><h2>Investigation complete!</h2><p>All five case badges earned. You examined data, sources, and competing interpretations—just like a historian.</p><p><strong>'+Object.values(state.firstTry).filter(Boolean).length+' first-try stars</strong> collected. The real win is what you learned when the evidence changed your mind.</p><button onclick="restart()">Play again from the beginning</button></section>':'';
 document.getElementById('workspace').innerHTML='<section class="stage"><div class="stage-head"><span class="tag">'+escapeHTML(m.tag)+'</span><span class="case-label">'+(caseClosed?'CASE CLOSED ✓':'ACTIVE CASE FILE')+'</span></div><h2>'+escapeHTML(m.title)+'</h2><p class="intro">'+vocab(m.intro)+'</p>'+missionHTML+'<div class="figures">'+figures+'</div>'+reading+'<p class="muted small">Choose an answer and check your thinking. Wrong answers unlock a chance to reconsider, not a penalty. After a wrong attempt, you can retry or reveal the answer and explanation.</p>'+qhtml+'</section>'+badgesHTML+'<div class="actions nav-actions"><button '+(state.module===0?'disabled':'')+' onclick="chooseModule('+(state.module-1)+')">← Previous case</button><button '+(state.module===CASE_COUNT-1?'disabled':'')+' onclick="chooseModule('+(state.module+1)+')">Next case →</button></div>'+end;
}
function enlargeImage(img){const w=window.open('','_blank','noopener');if(w){w.document.write('<title>Historical source — zoom</title><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width"><body style="margin:0;background:#172c38;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:100vh"><img alt="Enlarged historical source" style="max-width:100%;max-height:100vh;object-fit:contain" src="'+img.src+'"></body>');w.document.close();}else {img.classList.toggle('zoomed');}}
function enlargeKey(event,img){if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();enlargeImage(img)}}
function chooseModule(i){if(i<0||i>=CASE_COUNT)return;state.module=i;render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}
function chooseAnswer(i,n){if(state.checked[i])return;state.chosen[i]=n;render()}
function toggleHint(i){state.hints[i]=!state.hints[i];render()}
function checkAnswer(i){if(state.chosen[i]===undefined||state.checked[i])return;const q=DATA.questions[i];state.attempts[i]=(state.attempts[i]||0)+1;if(state.chosen[i]===q.answer){state.checked[i]=true;state.firstTry[i]=(state.attempts[i]===1);const m=DATA.modules[state.module];if(caseSolved(m)===caseQuestions(m).length&&!state.celebrated[m.id]){state.celebrated[m.id]=true;}}render();}
function revealAnswer(i){if(!(state.attempts[i]>0)||state.checked[i])return;state.checked[i]=true;state.revealed[i]=true;state.firstTry[i]=false;render()}
function restart(){if(totalSolved()&&!confirm('Restart all five cases? Your current progress will reset.'))return;state.chosen={};state.checked={};state.hints={};state.attempts={};state.firstTry={};state.celebrated={};state.revealed={};state.module=0;render();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}
render();
</script></body></html>
